page.layout: One page of text; running head at top; two headed poems in italic verse with a large initial; a short line at the lower right edge ("Hunca") partly cut off.

l.i: Illisque cunctis ille qua rerum parens
Impune in ipsos Principum irruens thronos,
Nam dia cuncta ceu tuetur Veritas,

main_text.l: Regna ergo, regna quamdiu Deus sinet,

l.i: At, pauculi vos, Veritas quibus placet,
Nam tempus aderit, Mundus atque Falsitas
Quum pariter vno corruent sic impetu,
Vt illa Mundum, & Mundus illam pertrahat

main_text.l: Velle: Velle, quum decuit tacere, fari:

page.notes: Large initial letters Q and I are decorative; the initial "I" of the first poem is a woodcut initial. The final word at lower right is partly cut off by the page edge and is uncertain. Some italic letters (e.g. long s rendered as s) are as printed.
